in_hebrew.name: Livy
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Livy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'livus', meaning 'lively' or 'yellow'. In ancient Rome, it was a surname for the yellow-haired. In Greek mythology, Livy was an epithet of the goddess of grain, Ceres.

in_greek.name: Livy
in_greek.long_meaning: Livy είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Latin word 'livus', meaning 'lively' or 'yellow'. In ancient Rome, it was a surname for the yellow-haired. In Greek mythology, Livy was an epithet of the goddess of grain, Ceres.

in_latin.name: Livy
in_latin.long_meaning: Livy est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Latin word 'livus', meaning 'lively' or 'yellow'. In ancient Rome, it was a surname for the yellow-haired. In Greek mythology, Livy was an epithet of the goddess of grain, Ceres.
